column3: The Hebrew emphasizes redeeming by repeating the verb, without a wishing verb; BSB says “wishes to redeem.”
The Hebrew describes the tithe of herd “and” flock and says “the rod”; BSB uses “herd or flock” and adds “shepherd’s.”
The Hebrew uses singular “it shall not be redeemed”; BSB uses plural “they cannot be redeemed.”
The Hebrew repeats the command verb in “the commandments which the LORD commanded”; BSB says “the commandments that the LORD gave.”
